answer: Score decay, not signup spikes. Reputation in this economy behaves like an ember fed by a glacier: it only glows while steady, low-variance activity keeps arriving over many epochs. A sybil island can shout loudly for a week, but maintaining plausible cadence across dozens of wallets demands real ongoing effort per wallet. Farm the cost curve, not the count: bursty accounts cool fast; slow, varied histories stay warm.
